body: Job 2145: a consumed terminal approval interrupted before merge arming is absent from ready_gates and status --next, so workflow startup cannot discover it automatically
Job 2145: clearing mod-block before terminalization and archival makes the shipped PR merge path interruption-unsafe
Job 2146: startup and idle exclude an interrupted terminal entity carrying pr-merge after mod-block is cleared
Jobs 2146, 2147, and 2153: split-root merge guard commits the archive move locally without synchronizing that final commit to the remote state branch
Job 2147: the restart fixture cleared the wrong mod-block value and could pass without constructing the intended terminal sentinel and empty-block precondition
Job 2147: recovery recognizes pr-merge but not the canonical local-merge sentinel accepted by merge guard
Job 2147: the shipped mod behavior changed without a version bump, so refit would not offer the recovery update
Job 2153: the dev template canary checked only its reconciled version and could miss loss of the local-merge selector
Jobs 2153 and 2158: structural selector parity plus direct merge guard restart coverage does not execute startup or idle discovery, gh bypass, and archival end to end
Job 2153: the terminal restart test name still said blocked although its corrected precondition is unblocked
Job 2158: the template canary failure prints pipe-joined expected fragments, which can resemble literal source text

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: cycle 13 limits automatic terminal recovery to an already armed merge ceremony while named-entity consumed resume remains supported and a new boot projection exceeds the approved boundary; promotes-when: the captain requires workflow-level automatic recovery for the post-consume pre-arm interruption window

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: remote durability is material to the prerelease but owned by the separate durable-decisions synchronization task and changing merge guard or state push semantics exceeds this nine-file entity; promotes-when: that owner fails to land the supported conflict-safe archive synchronization before release

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: the approved proof boundary explicitly forbids a new hook harness and retains paired template selector parity plus both-sentinel direct restart behavior and versioned rollout; promotes-when: an existing hook execution harness becomes approved or a live trigger shows discovery or gh bypass failure

class: correct-but-disproportionate; why-not-material: the diagnostic affects only developer readability after an already correct test failure and no released workflow or protected boundary depends on its formatting; promotes-when: the output causes a supported maintainer to misdiagnose a real selector parity failure

reason: triage: 7 material findings fixed; 4 declined with explicit promotion conditions
